item.title: PHP Loose vs Strict Comparison == vs === Pitfalls Explained
item.description:
“PHP Loose vs Strict Comparison == vs === Pitfalls Explained”

The Surprise of Loose Comparison (==)

The core issue arises when PHP attempts to reconcile different data types during a loose comparison (==). The mechanism involves type coercion—casting one operand to match the type of the other.

Type Coercion Rules in PHP (Pre-PHP 8.0)

Before PHP 8.0, when comparing a number with a string using ==, the string was often cast into a numeric type before the comparison. This led to results that defy intuition:
